constitutional_basis: Article XXXVI §6 (simulator registry; MCX/PyTissueOptics deviation justified)
Article XXXVI §8 (economics must use verified number)
Article XV (coder must disclose inconvenient results)
R308_history: P-16 reported 744 uW at 940nm. Diffusion approximation vs Kubelka-Munk disagreed 60-70%. Neither independently verified.
R310_protocol: 4-model comparison: diffusion approx + Kubelka-Munk + Monte Carlo (MCX-style) + Monte Carlo (PyTissueOptics-style). Compare to published Jacques 2013 measurements.

frozen_phantom_geometry.source_type: isotropic point source at tissue surface (z=0)
frozen_phantom_geometry.detector_type: PV cell at z=5mm, 1 cm^2 active area, centered on source x-y position

frozen_optical_properties_940nm.source: Jacques 2013, Phys Med Biol 58:R37-R61, brain tissue surrogate

anti_patterns_forbidden: Choosing the attractive 744 uW result if Monte Carlo disagrees (Article XV)
Widening tolerance after the comparison run (Article VIII)
Skipping the published measurement comparison (Article XXVI)
Treating any single model as infallible (Article XXVI)

published_reference.citation: Jacques SL, Optical properties of biological tissues: a review, Phys Med Biol 58:R37-R61 (2013)
published_reference.expected_fluence_range_mW_per_cm2: 0.5 to 2.0 mW/cm^2 (estimated from Fig 11 + 940nm tissue penetration depth ~5mm)
published_reference.note: Exact published value at 940nm/5mm depends on tissue type. We use the Jacques 2013 review's brain/soft tissue surrogate. The CONVERGED Monte Carlo result should fall in this range if the optical properties are correct.
